entries.label: Bus layover
entries.reason: Authored lane use. A bus waiting between runs stands in a layover, which parking-kind has named since version 1 while lane-use could not say it: a layover carries no through traffic, so its traffic is none, and it is as wide as the bus lane it comes off. Its turning radius is a layover carries no through traffic, so no vehicle turns out of one: the minimum_turning_radius_mm of assets/catalogs/traffic/vehicle-class.v1.json, sha256 1da3a44f919228a97719e54821bed2c9a1218cd6c1699ec2ee5d54d4591c35f8, whose classes lane-use-access maps to this use.
